description: Agent pool sandboxes (ADR 0003): source-tracked Developer sandboxes leased one per story. Each one's admin login, instance URL and JWT key live in the sandbox-pool GitHub environment (SANDBOX_USERNAME_<NAME>, SANDBOX_URL_<NAME>, SANDBOX_CLIENT_ID_<NAME>, SANDBOX_JWT_KEY_<NAME>). Every lease brings the sandbox up to integration, so where it was copied from doesn't matter.
